Discuss how likely the predictions below are.  • Privacy will become a thing of the past. • By the early 2030s, we will be able to copy human consciousness to a computer. • Wireless Internet connection will be available anywhere on our planet. • All forms of transport will eventually become electric. • The effects of climate change will be irreversible. • Physical money (coins and notes) won't exist anymore. • Scientists will unlock the genetic secrets that could allow us to live for centuries, maybe forever.

message.content:
Privacy will likely erode, yet total disappearance remains low because law, encryption, and social pushback will endure; the forecast is possible but not certain: Privacy
By the early 2030s, copying human consciousness to a computer is extremely unlikely; the science, compute, and ethical barriers are immense, so the prediction is very low-odds By
Wireless Internet everywhere by mid-century is plausible, but full global coverage in the 2030s is less certain due to cost, power, and terrain; still, progress is strong, Wireless
All transport becoming electric eventually is likely over long timescales, yet heavy aviation, shipping, and infrastructure will lag; the claim is high probability eventually, All
The likelihood of irreversible climate effects is high for some losses like ice sheets and species, but not for all; the prediction is very likely in part and less clear overall, The
Physical money disappearing everywhere is moderate to low globally, because cash remains useful for privacy, resilience, and low-cost payments; partial decline is likely, Physical
Scientists unlocking genetic secrets for centuries or immortality in the near future is very unlikely; biology presents too many systemic barriers, though life extension may advance, Scientists
